policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Franklin Pierce kept Bentley scoreless in the first match between two NE10 sides this season, and their eleven goals now trail only Southern New Hampshire's fourteen. Bentley have conceded nine in four matches and have lost the last two of them.

claims.text: The two tallest bars are built differently: nine players have scored Southern New Hampshire's fourteen goals, while Franklin Pierce's eleven come from four.
